column1: # Mount smoke-test matrix. Tab-separated: name  fixture  fs_flag  layout  subpath  expected
# layout: disk -> mounted through the forensic-vfs engine + MultiPartitionFs, so
#         every disk/archive/logical fixture surfaces at ro/<volume>/<path> on
#         Linux (overlay). A bare filesystem, an archive (zip/7z/tar), and an
#         AFF4-Logical container are one volume named `root`; AD1 carries its own
#         inner `root/` dir (hence root/root/...). The engine's ISO9660 reader
#         yields uppercase 8.3 names (no Rock Ridge/Joliet), so iso asserts
#         mem  -> ForensicFs tree at the root (sys/...).
# fs_flag is advisory: the engine auto-detects container/volume/fs, so --fs is
#         ignored for disk rows; only `memory` forces the memory route.
# Committed fixtures: exfat.img, hfsplus.img, apfs.img, ad1.ad1, aff4-logical.aff4,
# crash.dmp. The rest are minted by gen-fixtures.sh. expected = a substring that
# must appear in the read file.
